newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton prices held steady on Thursday in selective trading and dealers said rates would stay littled changed in the next few days, helped by interest from exporters.

"Overall trading activity is low and most deals are being made on credit," dealer Kishan Chand said. "But there has been some interest from exporters in good quality stocks which would keep the rates stable at present."
In the kerb, NIAB-78 variety was traded between 1,900 rupees ($47.24) to 2,100 rupees per maund (37.32 kg).
